routing_warnings.description: The report of too many pauses and request for smoother delivery concern the separate pacing-and-smoothness Requirement.
The request to edit the second and third takes concerns delivery of edited selected takes rather than pacing and smoothness.
The request to send the two edited takes separately concerns audio-file packaging rather than pacing and smoothness.
The excessive-pauses and smoother-delivery feedback concerns pacing and smoothness rather than the provision of alternate takes.
The request for an inspiring delivery with pride concerns tone and energy rather than the provision of alternate takes.
The request to edit both selected takes belongs to the edited-selected-takes Requirement.
The request to send the two edited takes separately concerns audio-file packaging.
The request to send the two edited takes separately also establishes separate-file delivery behavior.
